The Senior Advisor, Student Affairs Mitigators (SAMs) is a confidential, exempt professional serving as a key operational leader within UCLA Student Affairs and the division of Campus Life. Reporting to the Manager, Student Affairs Mitigators (SAMs) and working closely with the Chief of Risk & Compliance, the Senior Advisor advances UCLA's educational mission by promoting student success, protecting student rights, fostering student wellbeing, and supporting a safe, inclusive campus environment that encourages free expression and respectful engagement. The Senior Advisor provides leadership for the Student Affairs Mitigator (SAM) Program by educating and advising students, student leaders, and campus partners on Time, Place, and Manner (TPM) policies, First Amendment principles, risk management, and campus resources. The position supports the planning and implementation of compliance, emergency preparedness, and student engagement initiatives while serving as a frontline leader during demonstrations, major campus events, labor actions, and other high-impact activities. Through real-time observation, communication, de-escalation, and coordination with campus partners, the Senior Advisor helps promote student safety, operational continuity, and the effective resolution of complex campus situations. As a member of the University's tiered-response framework, the Senior Advisor also functions as an operational liaison to the Emergency Operations Center (EOC) during campus disruptions, including demonstrations, labor actions, and other significant events. In this capacity, the position routinely handles confidential, labor-sensitive, and operational information that supports institutional decision-making and labor relations strategy. In addition, the Senior Advisor will be closely coordinating activities and reporting in real time with Labor Relations and other critical partners, including the AVC for Campus & Community Safety, the VCSA, the AVC of Campus Life, and the AVC's of Student Affairs. This includes real-time reporting and tracking of on-the-ground activity to communicate protest activity, strike actions, and demonstrations as they unfold, as well as identifying the need for any building or area closures, working directly with the EOC command center and Labor Relations. The Senior Advisor will correspond and coordinate through all confidential communication channels, including Slack, radios, and cell phones, to ensure timely, secure information-sharing across these sensitive operations. Due to this direct involvement in EOC operations, access to confidential labor relations information, and potential conflicts of interest, the position is designated Confidential (Employee Relations Code F) in accordance with PPSM.
